title: Sylvester Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Sylvester Thompson." Historical Document Record (2006). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Funeral program cover: 'In Loving Memory Of Sylvester Elwood Thompson - Sunrise June 13, 2006 [sic; the obituary gives his birth as June 13, 1945] - Sunset September 15, 2006 - Friday, September 22, 2006, Viewing 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM, Service 11:00 AM - Dickerson Chapel A.M.E. Church, 165 South DuPont Highway, Millsboro, DE 19966 - Reverend Richard H. Worthy, Officiating.' Portrait of Sylvester Thompson on the cover. Program photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
